name: Email Bulk Deliverability Check
description: Upload a whole file of addresses, find out which ones can receive mail, and download the result when it finishes.

result_fields.name: activated
result_fields.description: Whether the address is deliverable — whether it can receive mail.

result_fields.name: result
result_fields.description: Deliverability outcome, e.g. `deliverable`. The value passes through from the verification engine.

result_fields.name: reason
result_fields.description: Why that outcome was reached, e.g. `accepted_email`. The value passes through from the verification engine.
